name: Dance
description:
Grants Poised to Sword Dance, Tempted to Tango, Jitterbugged, or Willing to Waltz, allowing the execution of an action depending on the effect granted.
Phantom Sword Dance Effect: Delivers an attack with high potency
Tempting Tango Effect: Deals unaspected damage and freezes time
Jitterbug Effect: Deals unaspected damage, absorbing a portion of damage dealt as HP, and afflicts target with Paralysis
Mystery Waltz Effect: Deals unaspected damage, afflicts target with Blind, and restores MP
